**Job Purpose**
Global [Product] Operations is looking for a Lead Analytics Engineer, Portfolio Reporting to own how we measure and communicate engineering delivery, release health, and portfolio performance. This is a business-facing role: you will own the metrics and reporting priorities for the portfolio, partnering with product, engineering, and program leaders to understand the decisions they need to make, prioritize reporting needs, establish trusted metrics, and explain what the results mean and where action is needed.
  
  
This role combines reporting program ownership, stakeholder partnership, and hands-on technical leadership. You will turn a backlog of requests into a focused reporting program and deliver it through our existing Databricks data platform and analytics application, building reliable data pipelines, Python services, and React reporting experiences. You will also improve AI-assisted access to analytics through MCP and natural-language querying.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will own delivery from business requirements through implementation, adoption, and ongoing reliability, while setting technical direction and guiding contributors. Success depends on both sound engineering and the ability to help leaders understand performance and make better decisions.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Reporting priorities and stakeholder partnership:**

* Partner with product, engineering, and executive stakeholders to understand their business questions, the decisions reporting should support, and the value they expect.

* Deliver reporting across engineering performance, release health, dependencies, backlog health, and cross-product roadmaps.

**Portfolio Insight And Metric Ownership**

* Own portfolio metric definitions, working with product and engineering leaders to establish consistent, meaningful measures. Reconcile differences across source systems and team workflows, and explain where work mix, data coverage, or other limitations affect comparisons.

description:

**Job Details**
**Salesforce Service Team**
**Job Summary**
The Salesforce Senior Business Analyst on the Salesforce Service Team will serve as the critical bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, driving the discovery, documentation, and delivery of Salesforce Service Cloud solutions at Cencora. This role is responsible for deeply understanding business processes within customer service, case management, and support operations, and translating those needs into clear, actionable requirements that enable the development team to deliver high-impact Salesforce solutions. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical skills, hands-on Salesforce knowledge, and a proven ability to lead requirements-gathering sessions, facilitate workshops, and champion continuous process improvement across service operations.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders in customer service, support operations, and contact center teams and the Salesforce technical delivery team
* Lead and facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, JAD (Joint Application Design) sessions, and stakeholder interviews to elicit, document, and validate business requirements
* Translate complex business needs into detailed user stories, process flows, use cases, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications aligned with Agile delivery standards
* Analyze and document current-state (As-Is) and future-state (To-Be) business processes related to case management, omni-channel routing, knowledge management, and customer service workflows

* Identify opportunities for process automation and optimization within service operations using Salesforce Flow, Einstein AI, and other platform tools
* Support change management activities including stakeholder communication, training material development, and end-user training delivery
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog in collaboration with the Product Owner, ensuring stories are well-defined, estimated, and sprint-ready
* Partner with reporting and analytics teams to define and validate KPIs, dashboards, and reports that measure service performance and operational efficiency

* 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 3+ years focused on Salesforce implementations
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, including Case Management, Omni-Channel, Knowledge Base, and Entitlements
* Strong proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies, including writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and managing product backlogs
* Experience facilitating requirements workshops, stakeholder interviews, and process mapping sessions with cross-functional teams
* Proficiency with business analysis tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Lucidchart, Visio, or equivalent
* Strong understanding of Salesforce declarative capabilities including Flows, Validation Rules, Page Layouts, and Record Types
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience coordinating and leading UAT activities including test case development and defect management
* Active Salesforce Certified Administrator certification

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant certification
* Salesforce Certified Business Analyst certification
* Experience with Salesforce Einstein AI features such as Einstein Case Classification, Einstein Article Recommendations, or Einstein Bots within a service context
* Familiarity with CTI (Computer Telephony Integration) platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys, or Avaya integrated with Salesforce
* Experience working with Agentforce for AI-powered customer service automation
* Knowledge of ITIL or other service management frameworks and their application to Salesforce Service implementations
* Experience with Salesforce Field Service (FSL) or Salesforce Experience Cloud (Community portals for self-service)
* Familiarity with integration concepts and their impact on service data flows
* Understanding of data governance, data quality standards, and reporting best practices within Salesforce
* Experience in the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industry
* Proven experience supporting large-scale, enterprise Salesforce implementations with multiple concurrent workstreams

Bachelor's degree in business administration, computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. 4+ years of experience in technical product management, technical business analysis, solution architecture, or a related field required. * Develop and improve scalable sales process landscapes and translate business requirements into practical, user-friendly sales tools.

* Work with business users and IT teams to validate system changes and ensure requirements are met.
* Create and maintain process documentation, user guides, process standards, and adoption materials.
* Support rollout, training, and adoption of sales processes and tools.
* Identify and escalate adoption challenges, tool issues, process gaps, and data-quality risks.
* Collaborate with Sales, Business Analysts, IT/CRM Support, BI/Data teams, Sales Management, and other stakeholders.
* Support requirements related to KPIs, analytics, dashboards, reporting, and data quality.
* Gather user feedback and translate it into actionable process and tool improvements.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives in an international and cross-functional environment.

* Strong understanding of sales processes, CRM systems, G2M workflows, and Corporate Sales requirements.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear and practical process and tool requirements.
* Experience with process mapping, testing, documentation, UAT, and user adoption.
* Strong understanding of workflow improvement and process optimization.
* Ability to identify inefficiencies and recommend automation or process simplification.
* Understanding of data quality, reporting logic, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics requirements.
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, IT, Analytics, Business Analysts, and Process Owners.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving abilities.
* User-centric approach with the ability to understand business-user challenges.
* Ability to prioritize improvements and manage multiple requirements effectively.
* Comfortable working in a cross-functional and international environment.

**Preferred Profile**

* Experience working with CRM platforms and sales tools.
* Experience in Sales Operations, Business Process Improvement, Process Excellence, or Tool/Product Management.
* Exposure to automation, workflow optimization, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, reporting, and data analytics.
* Experience coordinating with IT teams for system enhancements and tool implementation.
* Experience supporting user training, change management, and adoption.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
The ideal candidate should be someone who can
**bridge the gap between business/sales teams and technology teams**
.
  
  
You should be comfortable understanding business processes, identifying gaps, converting requirements into actionable tool/process changes, coordinating testing, and ensuring successful adoption by users.
  
  
Key Hiring Parameters
  
  
**Core Areas:**
Sales Processes | CRM | G2M | Process Improvement | Tool Management | UAT | Data Quality | Analytics
  
  
**Interview Process:**
2 Rounds

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst and Scrum Master to support the delivery of business and technology transformation initiatives within the telecommunications domain. The role requires strong expertise in requirements gathering, process analysis, stakeholder engagement, agile delivery practices, and data analysis. The successful candidate will work closely with business and technical teams to translate business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, and solution outcomes while driving collaboration across cross-functional and international teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct workshops, interviews, and stakeholder discussions to gather and analyse business requirements
* Elicit, validate, document, and manage business and functional requirements throughout the project lifecycle
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Maintain requirements traceability and ensure alignment between business objectives and solution delivery
* Act as the key liaison between business stakeholders and software delivery teams
* Facilitate effective communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Manage stakeholder expectations and support prioritisation of requirements and scope
* Analyse current-state (as-is) and future-state (to-be) business processes
* Identify process improvement and automation opportunities
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Solution Designers, Architects, Developers, and Testers to support solution design activities
* Clarify business rules and functional requirements to enable successful solution delivery
* Define acceptance criteria and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities
* Prepare and maintain key project documentation, including:

+ Business Requirement Documents (BRD)
+ Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS)
+ User Stories
+ Process Flow Diagrams
+ Business Cases
+ Gap Analysis Documents
+ UAT Test Scenarios

* Support agile delivery teams and contribute to successful Scrum ceremonies and practices

**Who You Are**

* Experience in requirements analysis and business process mapping
* Strong experience in data analysis and interpreting business insights
* Knowledge of SAFe and Agile methodologies
* Proven problem-solving and analytical capabilities
* Telecom industry knowledge and domain understanding
* Hands-on experience with tools such as:

+ JIRA
+ Confluence
+ Azure DevOps
+ Power BI
+ SQL
+ Lucidchart
+ BPMN modelling tools

* Demonstrated success working as a Scrum Master
* Experience within IT and/or telecommunications environments
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work collaboratively across diverse and cross-functional teams
* Experience working with multi-location international teams is desirable

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to work on large-scale telecommunications transformation initiatives
* Exposure to global stakeholders and international delivery teams
* Involvement in end-to-end project lifecycles, from business analysis through to testing and delivery
* Opportunity to influence process optimisation and automation initiatives
* Collaborative environment that supports agile ways of working and continuous improvement
* Exposure to modern delivery and analytical tools used across enterprise technology programmes

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced business analysis and requirement management techniques
* Agile and SAFe framework implementation within enterprise environments
* Stakeholder management across global and cross-functional teams
* Process design, optimisation, and automation identification methodologies
* Data-driven decision-making using Power BI, SQL, and analytics tools
* Agile delivery leadership and Scrum facilitation practices
* Telecommunications business processes and technology transformation expertise

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. **Join Us**

description:

Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity
  
  
With 4,300 employees and over 400,000 retail and institutional clients from more than 80 offices spread across five continents, we’re a Fortune-100, Nasdaq-listed provider, connecting clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, The StoneX Group is made up of four segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
Business Segment
  
  
**Payments**
: A Swift-accredited service bureau and member, our Payments division provides NGOs, institutions and non-profits the ability to make a local difference, globally – with transparent pricing across 180+ countries and 140+ currencies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Position Purpose:**
The Business Analyst role in the StoneX Global Payments business is essential to ensure effective requirement management, structured backlog creation, and seamless product delivery aligned with the product owner’s vision. As StoneX undergoes a critical phase of consolidating internal applications and standardizing new platforms, the need for a strong BA function becomes even more important. The role serves as a key enabler in prioritizing product requirements, simplifying complex solutions, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality, scalable products.
  
  
Responsibilitie s – The Business Analyst will support the delivery of global payments solutions by gathering, analyzing, and translating business requirements into actionable stories. The role focuses on cross-border payments processing, SWIFT messaging (MT/MX), and statement reconciliation , ensuring accurate, scalable, and compliant solutions
  
  
Primary duties will include :
  
  

* Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements for payment and reconciliation systems
* Convert requirements into structured user stories with clear acceptance criteria
* Maintain and groom the product backlog aligned with product priorities
* Analyze and map SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 MX messages across systems
* Work with bank statements (MT940/950, CAMT.053) and reconciliation logic
* Translating complex payment flows into clear functional solutions
* Support UAT, defect triage, and validation of MT/MX outputs
* This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and can be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities that management deems necessary.

**To land this role you will need**
: Minimum Qualifications (Must Haves). List here the minimum things required to perform/get the job, candidates who don’t meet these will not be considered
  
  
Strong understanding of:
  
  

* Strong understanding of Cross-border payments and correspondent banking, Payment lifecycle and settlement concepts.
* SWIFT messaging: MT (MT103, MT202, MT9XX) and MX (ISO 20022 – PACS, CAMT)
* Payment lifecycle and settlement concepts
* Requirement gathering and documentation
* User story writing (preferably Agile/Scrum)
* Data analysis and mapping (good with Excel)
* APIs / file-based integrations
* Strong communication and stakeholder management
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving

**What makes you stand out:**
Nice to Haves. Candidates who meet these secondary qualifications will be considered suitable candidates. - Best practice is to limit to 3-5 bullet points
  
  

* Exposure to reconciliation processes , including transaction matching and break management
* Understanding of Auto Matching / Intelligent Matching (AI/ML-based matching) concepts
* Rule-based vs ML-based matching approaches

title: BCM-BA - TechnoFunctional-CapitalMarket-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Capital Markets Techno-Functional Business Analyst**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Capital Markets Techno-Functional Business Analyst (Senior Consultant level) with experience in Capital Markets, Treasury, and Financial Markets transformation programs. The role requires a blend of business analysis, functional consulting, technology understanding, and stakeholder management capabilities to support platform implementation, integration, migration, and modernization initiatives across Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk, Finance, and Operations functions. The successful candidate will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, support testing, and drive the delivery of complex change programs across global financial institutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Engage with business, operations, risk, finance, and technology stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
* Facilitate workshops, process walkthroughs, stakeholder interviews, and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Produce high-quality BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows.
* Perform gap analysis, impact assessments, process reviews, and future-state operating model design.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability between business requirements, solution design, testing activities, and implementation deliverables.
* Support business readiness, change management, and operational transition activities.

**Capital Markets Functional Analysis**

* Analyze and document Front-to-Back trade lifecycle processes across Capital Markets and Treasury functions.
* Support initiatives involving trade capture, lifecycle management, confirmations, settlements, securities processing, reconciliations, collateral management, corporate actions, accounting, and reporting.
* Collaborate with Operations, Risk, Finance, Compliance, and Technology teams to define business processes and control frameworks.
* Assist in the design and implementation of target-state business processes and operating models.
* Support regulatory, operational, and transformation initiatives impacting Capital Markets functions.

**Technology & Integration Support**

* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Define functional requirements for platform enhancements, integrations, workflow automation, reporting, and data solutions.
* Analyze upstream and downstream system dependencies, interfaces, and data flows.
* Develop source-to-target mappings, support data analysis activities, and validate business data requirements.
* Support implementation, migration, integration, and platform modernization initiatives across Capital Markets ecosystems.

**Testing & Delivery**

* Create and review test scenarios, test cases, and business test data.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, end-to-end validation, and production verification activities.
* Coordinate defect triage, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication throughout testing cycles.
* Validate delivered functionality against business and regulatory requirements.
* Support deployment planning, implementation activities, and post-production stabilization.

**Domain Experience**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Treasury, or Financial Markets.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end trade lifecycle.
* Good knowledge of:

+ Trade Capture & Processing
+ Confirmations
+ Settlements
+ Securities Processing
+ Reconciliations
+ Collateral Management
+ Corporate Actions
+ Regulatory & Operational Controls

* Exposure to Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk, or Operations functions.

**Asset Class Knowledge**
Experience in one or more:
  
  

* Equities
* Fixed Income
* Foreign Exchange (FX)
* Money Markets
* Interest Rate Products
* Credit Products
* Derivatives (Futures, Options, Swaps)

**Platforms & Technology**

* Experience working on Capital Markets and Treasury platform implementation, enhancement, migration, or support programs.
* Exposure to platforms such as:

+ Murex
+ Calypso/Adenza
+ Kondor+
+ Finastra Solutions
+ FIS Quantum
+ Broadridge
+ MarkitSERV
+ Front Arena
+ Other Capital Markets, Treasury, or Post-Trade platforms

* Experience supporting integration, data migration, and platform modernization initiatives.

* Knowledge of Oracle, Sybase, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar database technologies.
* Experience performing data mapping, reconciliation, and data validation activities.
* Understanding of APIs, interfaces, messaging frameworks, and system integrations.
* Experience reviewing system impacts across multiple applications and data sources.
* Familiarity with Jira, Agile, Scrum, and related delivery methodologies.
* Experience supporting reporting solutions and business data validation

**Functional & Consulting Skills**

* Strong requirements gathering, business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to engage effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall, and global delivery environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, workstreams, and project deliverables.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to independently drive requirements and solution discussions.

**Desirable Knowledge**

* Experience supporting Capital Markets platform implementation, consolidation, or migration programs.
* Exposure to regulatory transformation initiatives and reporting requirements.
* Knowledge of financial market interfaces and messaging standards including SWIFT, FIX, MQ, XML, APIs, and ISO 20022.
* Experience working with investment banks, broker-dealers, custodians, exchanges, asset managers, or financial market infrastructures.
* Familiarity with trade and reference data management, reconciliation processes, and operational controls.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Business, or a related discipline (BE/BTech/MCA preferred).
* MBA (Finance) or relevant Capital Markets certification is advantageous.
* 5+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Treasury, Investment Banking, Financial Services Technology, or related consulting environments.
* Proven experience supporting business analysis, platform implementation, transformation, migration, or regulatory change programs.
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Scrum, Capital Markets, or Project Delivery are desirable.
* Experience working with global banks, broker-dealers, custodians, asset managers, exchanges, or financial institutions is preferred.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Domain Consultant — Wealth Management
description:
**Company Overview**
At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.
  
  
Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.
  
  
**Position Description**
We are seeking a mid-career domain specialist embedded in Bridgenext's financial services practice, focused on the US wealth management space. Works alongside solution architects and delivery teams to bring functional depth to pre-sales pursuits and active deliveries. Brings working knowledge of US wealth platforms, data flows, and regulatory context to shape better solutions and win more deals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
▸
**Domain Support in Pre-Sales:**
Participate in discovery calls, RFP responses, and solution workshops — contribute functional knowledge of US wealth operations to shape proposals and demos.
  
  
▸
**Requirements & Functional Design:**
Lead business requirements gathering, write functional specs, map current-state vs. future-state workflows for wealth clients (onboarding, portfolio management, reporting, compliance).
  
  
▸
**Platform Knowledge:**
Bring working knowledge of US wealth platforms — Tamarac (CRM, rebalancing, reporting), Salesforce FSC, Orion, Advent/APX — to inform solution design and integration strategy.
  
  
▸
**Data Analysis & Documentation:**
Support data-related workstreams — help define data models, map data flows between custodians/platforms/reporting tools, document data quality issues and governance gaps.
  
  
▸
**Client Interaction:**
Participate in and occasionally lead client workshops, UAT reviews, and business process walkthroughs with client stakeholders.
  
  
▸
**Thought Leadership:**
Contribute to internal knowledge base — document domain patterns, build reusable artifacts, assist with POVs and whitepapers.
  
  
▸
**Delivery Involvement:**
Act as a functional anchor on project teams — validate that what's being built reflects how wealth firms actually operate.
  
  
**Must Have Skills**
▸ 6–9 years of experience — either from the US wealth industry (operations, compliance, technology at an RIA, broker-dealer, custodian, or wealth tech firm) or from IT services consulting serving US wealth clients.
  
  
▸ Solid working knowledge of the US wealth ecosystem — understands the RIA/broker-dealer distinction, custodian models (Schwab, Fidelity, Pershing), advisor workflows, and regulatory basics (SEC, FINRA, Reg BI).
  
  
▸ Hands-on experience with at least 2–3 of: Envestnet | Tamarac, Salesforce FSC, Orion, Black Diamond, Advent/APX, Redtail, Morningstar.
  
  
▸ Data awareness — understands how wealth data flows (custodial feeds, account aggregation, portfolio accounting to reporting). Can read a data model, identify gaps, and work with engineering teams on data requirements.
  
  
▸ Comfortable presenting to client stakeholders and working in cross-functional teams.
  
  
▸ Strong documentation and communication skills — can turn a messy discovery session into a clean functional spec.
  
  
▸ Experience in at least 2–3 full project lifecycles involving US wealth clients.
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
▸ Exposure to Tamarac implementations or migrations.
  
  
▸ Salesforce FSC configuration or functional consulting experience.
  
  
▸ Familiarity with custodial data feeds and integration patterns (Plaid, Yodlee, MX).
  
  
▸ Understanding of GIPS, Form ADV, 13F, or other regulatory reporting.
  
  
▸ Awareness of AI/ML use cases in wealth — next-best-action, risk profiling, GenAI in investment research.
  
  
▸ CFA Level 1/2, CFP candidate, or Series 65/66.
  
  
▸ Familiarity with BI/reporting tools — Tableau, Power BI in a wealth context.
  
  
▸ Prior experience building domain knowledge bases or reusable frameworks at a services firm.
  
  
**Professional Skills**

* Solid written, verbal, and presentation communication skills
* Strong team and individual player
* Maintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by nature
* High standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality results
* Self-sufficient, independent requiring very little supervision or intervention
* Demonstrate flexibility and openness to bring creative solutions to address issues

description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Senior Salesforce Techno-Functional Specialist will strengthen Avient's internal Salesforce capability by translating commercial needs into scalable CRM solutions that maximize business value. Working across Sales, Marketing, Commercial, Labs, IT, and delivery partners, this role will advance global Salesforce operations, simplification, integrations, automation, and AI-enabled modernization of Avient's Lead-to-Land processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines business analysis, creative problem-solving, and strategic foresight with hands-on expertise in Salesforce's declarative low-code/no-code tools, including Flow and Admin configuration. The role will also provide functional direction and solution oversight for Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, and external development partners while promoting scalable standard solutions and avoiding unnecessary customization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Serve as Avient’s Salesforce techno-functional subject matter expert and trusted partner to Sales, Marketing, Commercial, Labs, IT, global application leadership, Salesforce Product Owners, and external delivery partners.
* Own and support Salesforce platform enhancements and continuous improvement across Salesforce, ensuring solutions align with business needs and Avient's broader application strategy.
* Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions, including process designs, user stories, functional specifications, configuration requirements, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
* Design and configure Salesforce solutions using declarative low-code/no-code capabilities, including Salesforce Flow, validation rules, field dependencies, page layouts, permission sets, profiles, roles, reports, dashboards, and other Admin-managed functionality.
* Design and execute coded Salesforce solutions, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, Aura, APIs, and integrations, or delegate development to partner resources and provide functional direction, technical oversight, and solution assurance to ensure business requirements are met without unnecessary customization.
* Advance Avient's AI-enabled and digital CRM roadmap by modernizing Lead-to-Land processes, simplifying the Salesforce user experience, reducing technical debt and unnecessary data capture, improving opportunity and pipeline management, automating commercial workflows, and supporting Salesforce AI and Agentforce use cases.
* Coordinate Salesforce integration requirements across the Avient application landscape, including SAP, BTP/middleware and other connected commercial applications as applicable.
* Improve Salesforce release management through solution impact analysis, sandbox testing, regression planning, deployment sequencing, business acceptance testing, documentation, and post-release validation.
* Drive Salesforce platform rationalization and technical-debt reduction by identifying opportunities to retire or simplify obsolete profiles, fields, objects, flows, applications, customizations, and unused platform capabilities.
* Support Salesforce platform governance and optimization, including security and access design, license utilization, evaluation of Salesforce-native applications such as Key Account Planning tools, configuration standards, documentation, and alignment with enterprise architecture and IT standards.

* A proven record of accomplishment of working both independently and as a member of a team.
* Communicates effectively with both technical IT audiences, and non-technical business audiences.

* Demonstrated problem solving skills and creativity applied to IT systems and business processes. A keen interest in and understanding of emerging technologies and their potential business applications.
